features: BLUETOOTH AUDIO RECEIVER: Converts any 3.5mm audio jack device into a Bluetooth-enabled receiver instantly.
USB POWERED: Simply plug into any USB port for power, making it convenient for car stereos, speakers, and headphones.
HIGH TRANSMISSION RANGE: Enjoy stable, wireless audio streaming with an impressive Bluetooth transmission range.
CALLING FUNCTION: Built-in calling function allows you to answer and manage calls hands-free with ease.
WIDE COMPATIBILITY: Works seamlessly with cars, portable speakers, headphones, and any device with a 3.5mm audio jack.
description: The USB Bluetooth Audio Receiver Dongle is a compact and versatile adapter that wirelessly streams audio to your existing wired speakers, headphones, or car stereo system. Simply plug it into any USB power source and connect it to your audio device via the 3.5mm audio jack to enjoy seamless Bluetooth connectivity. With its high transmission range, you can stream music from your smartphone, tablet, or laptop without interruptions or signal drops. The built-in calling function allows you to take hands-free calls with ease, making it especially useful while driving. Its plug-and-play design requires no complicated setup or additional drivers, making it incredibly convenient to use. Whether you want to upgrade your car audio system, breathe new life into your old wired speakers, or enjoy wireless music through your favourite headphones, this dongle is the perfect solution. Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry, it is an ideal accessory for both home and on-the-go use.
